content.zh-CN:
{userEmail} 您好，


{organization} 的管理员已为您注册了 TDengine IDMP，单击下面的按钮激活您的账户。

点击激活

请注意，该链接为临时链接，将在 24 小时后过期。


请务必为您的登录链接添加书签，以便以后轻松访问您的账户。 如果您在登录账户时遇到任何问题，请联系 cloud@taosdata.com。

如果您有其他问题，欢迎致电 4006120020 或访问TDengine 官网联系我们。


谢谢，

TDengine 团队
content.en:
Hi {userEmail},

You have been invited to work together in TDengine IDMP by the administrator of {organization}.

Click here to activate your account and get started. It's really that easy!

Note that this activation link is temporary and will expire in 24 hours.

If you experience any problems logging in to your account, contact us at support@tdengine.com.

Regards,

The TDengine Team
content.es:
